# Rendair AI

> > AI-powered architectural visualization platform that transforms sketches, floor plans, 3D models, and text into photorealistic renders for architects and designers.

Rendair AI is a comprehensive design tool that integrates with popular CAD software like AutoCAD, Revit, Rhino, SketchUp, and Blender. The platform offers multiple AI-driven rendering tools and flexible subscription plans ranging from free student access to professional team licenses.

## Key Topics

- AI rendering
- Architectural visualization
- Photorealistic renders
- Text-to-render
- Sketch-to-render
- 3D model rendering
- CAD integration
- Floor plan conversion
- Elevation rendering
- Section rendering
- Image-to-render
- Free credits
- Design tools
- Architecture software

## Core Platform

- [Rendair AI Homepage](https://rendair.ai): AI-powered platform for architects to create photorealistic renders
- [AI Tools Overview](https://rendair.ai/tools): Overview of all Rendair AI tools for architectural visualization and image editing

## AI Rendering Tools

- [Text to Render](https://rendair.ai/tools/text-to-render): Generate architectural visualizations from natural language prompts with 20 free credits
- [Sketch to Render](https://rendair.ai/tools/sketch-to-render): Transform hand sketches into photorealistic architectural renders
- [Floor Plan to Render](https://rendair.ai/tools/floorplan-to-render): Convert 2D floor plans from AutoCAD/Revit into 3D photorealistic renders
- [3D Model to Render](https://rendair.ai/tools/3d-model-to-render): Render 3D models from SketchUp, Revit, Rhino, Blender into photorealistic visuals
- [Elevation to Render](https://rendair.ai/tools/elevation-to-render): Convert 2D architectural elevations into photorealistic 3D renders for facade studies
- [Section to Render](https://rendair.ai/tools/section-to-render): Transform architectural section drawings into photorealistic 3D renders
- [Photo to Render](https://rendair.ai/tools/image-to-render): Transform photos into professional architectural renders
